evidence.V1: Pointed pickets, rails and post read as a picket fence from front, three-quarter and silhouette; top view still shows post plus picket row.
evidence.V2: Clear big post and rails, medium pickets with pointed tops, small post cap and nails.
evidence.V3: Picket proportions are good, but all pickets are identical height and evenly spaced; little stylised variation (no lean, height jitter or post taper).
evidence.V4: Pickets, rails, post and cap all carry consistent chamfers that catch light (close_rails_studio, close_post_cap_studio).
evidence.V5: Close-ups of post cap, rails and rail end are clean; no z-fighting, pinches or stray facets.
evidence.V6: Wood hue in 2-3 values (dark post, mid rails, light pickets) plus ink nails; disciplined in all colourways.
evidence.V8: One vertex-colour material, smooth chamfered timber and wood hue; indistinguishable from the kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line correct (Box collision, grid-corner pivot, white colour); T1 passes in contain mode.

top_fixes: Add slight per-picket height/lean variation and a gentle post taper for a more stylised, hand-built read
Put nails on every picket (2 each) instead of only three of them
Bevel or cap the open rail ends so the piece reads finished when not tiled
